tasks.description: Add an 'Export to CSV' button on the sales report page. This button should initiate a download of the currently displayed report when clicked.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sales report page is loaded, when the 'Export to CSV' button is clicked, then a download of the report is initiated.

tasks.description: Create a backend endpoint that generates the CSV for the requested report and streams the response to the client. This should handle large reports efficiently without buffering the entire file in memory.
acceptance_criteria: Given a large sales report, when the export endpoint is called, then the response is streamed to the client without significant memory usage.

tasks.description: Allow the user to choose which columns to include in the export before downloading. The generated CSV should include only the selected columns, in the displayed order.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sales report page is loaded, when the user selects specific columns, then the exported CSV includes only those columns in the correct order.

tasks.description: Encode the CSV per RFC 4180: quote fields containing commas, double quotes, or newlines, and escape embedded double quotes by doubling them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sales report with special characters, when the CSV is generated, then the fields are correctly escaped according to RFC 4180.

tasks.description: The first row of the CSV should contain the human-readable column names for the selected columns.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sales report with selected columns, when the CSV is generated, then the first row includes the human-readable column names.

tasks.description: Integrate the export button, streaming export endpoint, column selection, RFC 4180 escaping, and header row functionality to provide a seamless user experience.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sales report page is loaded, when the user clicks the 'Export to CSV' button, then a correctly formatted CSV file is downloaded with the selected columns and data.
